title: Dragon Ball Super Remake Star Confirms English Dub Will Be Newer Than You Think
content: Dragon Ball Super is about to kick off the official English dub release for its new remake anime series, and one of the stars behind it all has confirmed that Dragon Ball Super: Beerus is going to be much newer than fans might expect.
author: ComicBook

title: Dark Crunchyroll Fantasy Confirms Season 2 Spring Return After 4 Years With New Look
content: A dark fantasy anime that you can now find streaming with Crunchyroll has now set a Spring release for its return next year, and its second season has dropped a new look at its comeback after four long years.
author: ComicBook

title: Crunchyroll to Stream Medaka Kuroiwa is Impervious to My Charms 2nd Season Anime
content: The second season will debut in January 2027. Ryōta Iwasaki and Yū Serizawa reprise their roles as Medaka Kuroiwa and Mona Kawai, respectively. Yoshiaki Okumura returns to direct the second season at Synergy SP .
author: ANN

title: Falcom Reveals Sequel for The Legend of Heroes: Trails beyond the Horizon Game
content: The game launched on January 15 for Nintendo Switch 2, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, PlayStation 4, and PC via Steam . NIS America originally scheduled the game for a fall 2025 release, but delayed it along with the announcement of the Switch 2 version.
author: ANN

title: New Solo Leveling Contender Drops New Trailer Ahead of 2027 Release – Watch Now
content: Solo Leveling has had a lot of new anime releases coming for its crown over the last couple of years, and now a new contender is entering the fray when it kicks off its run next January.

title: SSS-Class Revival Hunter New Trailer Previews Ending Theme Song by THE SPELLBOUND x BOOM BOOM SATELLITES
content: SSS-Class Revival Hunter anime has released a new trailer featuring additional footage and a preview of its ending theme song “Fading” performed by THE SPELLBOUND × BOOM BOOM SATELLITES. The anime was previously announced for January 2027, with Crunchyroll set to stream it.

title: Mashle Season 3 Confirms Crunchyroll Release Date With New Trailer – Watch
content: Mashle: Magic and Muscles is gearing up for its highly anticipated return for a third season next year, and has now confirmed its release date ahead of its launch with Crunchyroll.

title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake Sells Over 5.2 Million Units to Become Nintendo's Fastest-Selling Switch 2 Game
content: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake launched on November 5. The remake adds traditional camera controls, motion controls, a proper jump button, and a roll dash action. Players can equip an item to the controller's ZR button, and switch between them in a pop-up menu.
author: ANN
